questions.say: Good morning. My name is Emma, and I'm your examiner today. This is the Speaking test. In this first part, I'd like to ask you some questions about yourself. Let's talk about your hometown. Where is your hometown?

questions.text: What do you like most about your hometown?

questions.text: Describe a child you know well.
questions.say: Thank you. Now, in Part 2, I'm going to give you a topic, and I'd like you to talk about it for one to two minutes. Before you talk, you'll have one minute to think about what you're going to say. You can make some notes if you wish. Here is your topic. Describe a child you know well. You should say: who the child is; how you know them; what this child likes doing; and explain how you feel about this child.

questions.text: Do you enjoy spending time with children in general?
questions.say: Thank you. Do you enjoy spending time with children in general?

questions.text: Is childhood today happier than it was in the past?
questions.say: Thank you. We've been talking about a child you know well, and I'd like to discuss with you some more general questions related to this. Let's consider first of all childhood. Is childhood today happier than it was in the past?

questions.text: What are the most important things children learn from their parents?

questions.text: How much should parents control what their children watch online?
